system.description:
You've learned to roll with the punches to reduce the damage you take by absorbing its impact.

Trigger: You would take damage from an Attack.

You are moved back 2 Spaces (or 2 additional spaces if the attack would already move you). You become Dropped, but you reduce the damage you take by an amount equal to your Grit or Reflex.

This ability cannot be used if you are already Dropped.
